title: ConversationRef
description: Which conversation of which coding agent: the engine, and the id the conversation has in that engine's own store. It is not the `sessionId` of a live session, which names a subprocess and ends with it; this one outlives every session that ever continued it, and is what the history reads and a resume takes (ADR-025).

engine.description: The engine — an `id` of `GET /engines`. Opaque to the client, which never decides by it.

id.description: The id of the conversation in the engine's store, in the engine's own form — opaque.
